description: Ministry of Sports - Order to made to amend the schedule ii to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1793/03 of 15.01.2013 by adding new Sport ie. ''61. Canoeing & Kayaking"
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which adds a new sport (Canoeing and Kayaking) to Schedule II of a previous order. This constitutes a regulatory amendment and falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes, which include statutory instruments, subsidiary legislation, and regulatory modifications.
